   My third map for campaign submissions, I was trying to take a different approach to making attack maps. No more laggy mechanics or out of pocket things to make map perfectly balanced: harder than than HochuPizzu, but easier than Explosives centre (tested with other players).

Description:


You start from the warm and welcoming edge of the equator, where the heat radiates from hot white sand and salt. With every step north, that warmth gradually fades, replaced by a piercing wind that sweeps across the barren landscape.

The air grows sharp and cold, and the terrain becomes increasingly severe and monolithic. Your path leads you through these vast expanses, and with each base you capture, you draw closer to your goal.

And ahead, never vanishing from the horizon, stand the icy peaks. Their snow-clad summits, gleaming in the distance, are the silent, constant landmark - the final objective of this ascent.

tags.description:
A remnant of a huge flying vessel, which purpose was to deliver supplies to other crux sectors before the crash. Now it's just a corroded piece of metal near archipelago.

Nevertheless, the enemy actively tries to salvage whatever they could find there, you should be careful.
tags.name: fallenVessel

tags.author: Skeledragon
tags.description:
Post-Planetary-Launch-Terminal challenge map, intended to be one of the penultimate challenges on campaign Serpulo.

Threat: [red]Eradication

[tan]An exceptionally well-fortified enemy production complex sits upon this volcanic hotspot. Prepare to face ferocious enemy assaults once your core lands.
tags.name: geothermalStronghold

tags.name: Lake

tags.author: Epowerj
tags.description: This sector contains varied terrain and will require a variety of units to attack effectively. Upgraded units may also be necessary to get past some of the tougher enemy bases detected here. Research the Electrolyzer and the Tank Refabricator.
tags.name: Atlas

tags.author: Epowerj
tags.description: The minimal enemy presence in this sector makes it perfect for testing new transport tech.
tags.name: Split

tags.author: Bepis
tags.description: No enemy cores detected in the sector, although it's an important transportation route for the enemy. Expect variety of enemy forces. Produce surge alloy. Construct [accent]Afflict[] turrets.

tags.author: Mechanical fishe
tags.description: A karst formation with alot of resources. Capture and research the assembler module and malign.
tags.name: Karst
